name: Sofia Ramirez
bio: Sofia Ramirez is a vibrant and dedicated artist from Mexico City, known for her bold, colorful murals and sculptures that often explore themes of heritage and identity. Having earned her undergraduate degree in Fine Arts from UNAM, she's built a successful career selling her work to galleries and private collectors, though she often finds herself immersed in late-night projects, driven by her passion. Despite her demanding work life, Sofia values connection and seeks a partner who appreciates her artistic drive and shares her love for the excitement of motorsports.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with subtle auburn highlights
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually worn in a high ponytail or a messy bun, framing her face
physical.description: Sofia has a warm, inviting smile and striking bone structure. She carries herself with confidence, often accentuated by her artistic flair in clothing.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Mexico City hosted by a team sponsor; she's there showcasing a piece inspired by the race.
firstImpression: Sofia's eyes sparkle with intelligence and a hint of mischief as she confidently discusses her art, seemingly unfazed by the high-profile environment.
dealBreakers: Intolerance of her demanding work schedule
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. Sofia appreciates practical help and support in her busy life. A partner who anticipates her needs and offers a helping hand will quickly win her over.
